stem:
The diagram shows Squares D, E, and F joined at vertices to form a right triangle.

Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The sum of the areas of Square D and Square F is less than the area of Square E.

options.label: B
options.text: The sum of the areas of Square D and Square E is greater than the area of Square F.

options.label: C
options.text: The sum of the areas of Square D and Square F is equal to the area of Square E.

options.label: D
options.text: The sum of the areas of Square D and Square E is equal to the area of Square F.

visual_elements: Diagram with three squares labeled Square D, Square E, and Square F arranged at vertices to form a right triangle.
